page: Google Cloud Platform c4-highmem-288-lssd is a high-capacity server powered by Intel Xeon 6985P-C processors with x86_64 architecture. It features 288 vCPUs mapped to 144 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled, running at a base clock speed of 2.3 GHz. The system is equipped with 2232 GB of RAM, providing approximately 7.75 GB of memory per core. Local storage is highly performant, consisting of 48 NVMe SSDs totaling 19031 GB of local capacity.

Benchmark results place this instance in the top tier for multi-core CPU performance, passmark CPU scores, and memory bandwidth across both cached and uncached large-block read/write operations. The CPU features advanced instruction sets including AVX-512 and Intel Advanced Matrix Extensions, which drive top-tier performance in extended instructions, cryptography, and software compilation. Database operations are highly optimized, with Redis SET operations achieving top-tier throughput. While prompt processing for large language models registers strong performance, text generation speeds for smaller models represent a comparative bottleneck.

Given its massive memory footprint, high vCPU density, and extensive local NVMe storage, this instance offers high qualitative cost efficiency for resource-intensive enterprise workloads. It is designed for large-scale databases, in-memory data stores, heavy multi-threaded data processing, and complex software compilation. The lack of dedicated GPUs makes it less suitable for heavy model training, but its AMX-accelerated CPU execution provides capable performance for CPU-based inference and data science pipelines.
description: Google Cloud Platform c4-highmem-288-lssd is a memory-optimized and storage-dense server powered by Intel Xeon 6985P-C processors on the x86_64 architecture. It delivers 288 vCPUs across 144 physical cores, paired with 2232 GB of RAM and 19031 GB of local NVMe SSD storage across 48 drives. Designed for high-throughput workloads, it achieves top-tier benchmarks in multi-core CPU performance, memory bandwidth, and Redis SET operations. The processor supports advanced instruction sets like AVX-512 and Intel AMX, enhancing cryptographic and matrix math operations. This server is highly suited for large-scale in-memory databases, heavy data processing, software compilation, and CPU-based machine learning inference.
